short_description: A side-lying stretch that opens the hip flexors and lengthens the side body.
how_to: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line.
Bend your top knee and reach back to hold your foot.
Gently pull your heel toward your glutes.
Hold where you feel a comfortable stretch, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your hips stacked on top of each other.
Keep your bottom arm extended under your head.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
Move into the stretch slowly and with control.
mistakes: Don't roll your hips forward or back.
Don't force your foot closer than is comfortable.

short_description: A standing arm movement that warms up the shoulders and upper back.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Extend both arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Cross your right arm over your left, then open them wide.
Alternate the crossing arm each rep in a steady scissors motion.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your chest open and your posture upright.
Keep your arms at shoulder height throughout.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
mistakes: Don't let your arms drop below shoulder level.
Don't hunch your shoulders toward your ears.

short_description: A lateral jump that trains leg power and improves coordination.
how_to: Stand with your feet together and a slight bend in your knees.
Push off your right foot and hop to the left.
Land on your left foot with a soft bend in the knee.
Immediately hop back to the right and continue alternating.
correct: Land softly.
Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your chest up and your gaze forward.
Keep your core tight throughout.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't lean your torso too far to the side.
Don't lock your knees on landing.

short_description: A prone Y-raise that strengthens the lower trapezius and rear shoulders.
how_to: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms off the floor.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower with control.
correct: Keep your neck neutral.
Move with control.
Keep your core gently braced.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top of each rep.
mistakes: Don't shrug your shoulders toward your ears.

short_description: A side-lying raise that targets the outer glutes and hip abductors.
how_to: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your body in a straight line.
Rest your head on your lower arm.
Keeping your top leg straight, lift it toward the ceiling.
Lower it with control and repeat, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your hips stacked throughout.
Keep your top leg straight as you raise it.
Move slowly rather than swinging the leg.
mistakes: Don't roll your hips backward to gain height.

short_description: A prone flutter kick that strengthens the lower back and glutes.
how_to: Lie face down with your arms flat by your sides.
Engage your glutes and lift both feet off the floor.
Alternate lifting each leg slightly higher in a fluttering motion.
Continue at a steady pace while breathing normally.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your neck neutral and your forehead near the floor.
Keep the kicks small and controlled.
Breathe steadily throughout.
mistakes: Don't kick so high that your lower back strains.

short_description: A prone push-up variation that isolates the triceps and challenges core stability.
how_to: Lie face down and place your hands under your shoulders with your elbows close to your sides.
Keep your neck neutral and your body in a straight line.
Press your palms into the floor and straighten your arms to lift your torso.
Lower back down with control and repeat.
correct: Keep your body straight.
Keep your elbows controlled.
Keep your neck neutral.
Move with control on the way down.
mistakes: Don't flare your elbows out wide.

short_description: A push-up variation where you pause just above the floor to build chest and triceps strength.
how_to: Start in a high push-up position with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower yourself toward the floor until you are a few centimetres from it.
Pause and hold that position for a breath.
Press back up to the start and repeat.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled as you lower.
Keep your core engaged during the hold.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't hold your breath during the pause.
Don't rush past the hold position.

short_description: A side-lying hip exercise that mobilises the hip joint and works the outer glutes.
how_to: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your body straight.
Lift your top leg to hip height.
Draw slow circles in the air with your raised foot.
Complete your reps, reverse direction, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your hips stacked and still.
Keep the circles smooth and controlled.
Keep your core gently engaged.
Breathe steadily throughout.
mistakes: Don't rock your hips to make the circles larger.
Don't tense your neck and shoulders.
Don't let the top leg drop between reps.

short_description: A floor-based squeeze that activates the rhomboids and improves upper-back posture.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Press the backs of your arms into the floor and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold the squeeze briefly, release, and repeat.
correct: Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Focus on drawing your shoulder blades toward each other.
Keep your chin tucked and your neck relaxed.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Don't press so hard that you strain your neck.
